name: testnet
description: Public hybrid testnet. Foundation bootstrappers listen on TCP 4040. Anyone may join by mining. The three bootstrappers are a named validator set (min stake 0) so dest REPOST/RECV can consume a prefix-cert QC. Not mainnet. MOD is the asset of the genesis MOD contract: 50 MOD per block (divisibility 1, 8 decimals), halving every 10080 blocks (about 7 days). A development mint, not the mainnet schedule. Predicate theory v3.

body.value:
model Mod {
  initial q0
  q0 --> q1: +POST
  q1 --> q2: +CREATE -SEND -RECV -modifies(/network) -modifies(/__programs__) +signed_by(/foundation.id)
  q2 --> q2: +SEND -CREATE -RECV -modifies(/network) -modifies(/__programs__) -modifies(/emission) +signed_by(/foundation.id)
  q2 --> q3: +modifies(/rules) -SEND -RECV -CREATE -modifies(/network) -modifies(/__programs__) +signed_by(/foundation.id)
  q3 --> q3: +emitted_by(/__programs__/emission.wasm, "ed16be6bf0e1f30c1ecdd28c90df0721b2aed18467218d1542fee7a58205713f") +tracks(/emission/emitted.num, "MOD", "issued") +mined_headers(/emission/blocks) -modifies(/network) -modifies(/__programs__)
}
